name: Akashi Sarina
source:
A barmaid who works at a well-known and secluded bar.
She has a sharp and handsome face and a fascinating body that radiates an exquisite sex appeal, her cool, caring, and good-natured personality attracts a great deal of attention.
She is more popular among female customers than male customers because of her good-looking appearance, and she is often consulted at the counter mainly on love affairs.
She is often seen as a "successful adult with a lot of experience in love" and as "someone who can win any man over".
In reality, however, she is a caretaker wife who works hard for her week and feeble husband.
Instead of playing a man's tricks, she is a woman who cannot refuse his requests and takes on unnecessary hardships when he asks her for help.
She loves her husband from the bottom of her heart and believes that if she continues to support him, he will become a great husband.


Translated from https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1236802&gc=gc
